 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Lifestyle Lifestyle Rocky to have fan concert in Manila in December 
 By GMA News Published November 10, 2026 3:47pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Courtesy: Rocky/Instagram Rocky is coming to Manila in December!
 The K-Pop idol is set to visit the country for his Fake It fan concert on December 20 at the Samsung Hall in SM Aura, Taguig City, according to Dark Star Entertainment.
 Ticket details and other information have yet to be announced.
 Rocky debuted as a member of the boy group Astro in 2016. He was also a member of its sub-unit, Jinjin & Rocky.
 In 2023, he decided to not renew his contract with Fantagio and left the group. That same year, Rocky released his debut solo EP, “Rockyst.”
 Rocky’s latest EP, “Unsaid,” came out in August.
 His songs include “Fake It,” “Jaywalking,” and “Hide and Seek.”
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by DarkStarEntertainment (@darkstar_ent_)
